Chapter 1

Exam Details and Resources考试概览与备考资源

This chapter addresses the most frequently asked questions by candidates preparing to successfully pass the Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) exam. Later chapters will give you a summary of Kubernetes’ benefits and architecture and how to interact with a Kubernetes cluster using kubectl.

本章回答备考 Certified Kubernetes Administrator（CKA）考试的考生最常问的问题。后续章节会概述 Kubernetes 的优势与架构，以及如何使用 kubectl 与 Kubernetes 集群交互。

Kubernetes Certification Learning PathKubernetes 认证学习路径

The Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) offers five different Kubernetes certifications. Figure 1-1 categorizes each of them by target audience.

云原生计算基金会（CNCF）提供五种不同的 Kubernetes 认证。图 1-1 按目标受众对它们进行了分类。

— PDF p.25 —

The target audience for associate-level certifications is beginners to the cloud and Kubernetes. Associate-level certification exams use a multiple-choice format. You will not have to interact with a Kubernetes cluster in an interactive environment.

associate（助理）级认证的目标受众是云和 Kubernetes 的初学者。associate 级考试采用选择题形式，你不需要在交互式环境中操作 Kubernetes 集群。

Practitioner-level certifications are meant for developers and administrators with pre-existing Kubernetes experience. Exams in this category require you to solve problems in multiple Kubernetes environments hands-on. You will find that the CKA is geared to administrators of a Kubernetes cluster and does not require any other certification as a prerequisite.

practitioner（从业者）级认证面向已有 Kubernetes 经验的开发者和管理员。这一类别的考试要求你在多个 Kubernetes 环境中动手解决问题。你会发现 CKA 面向 Kubernetes 集群管理员，并且不要求以任何其他认证作为前置条件。

If you pass all Kubernetes certifications, you can call yourself a Kubestronaut. The Kubestronaut program recognizes community members that are able to demonstrate their skills in the most important core areas of Kubernetes.

如果你通过了全部 Kubernetes 认证，就可以自称 Kubestronaut。Kubestronaut 计划表彰那些能够在 Kubernetes 最重要的核心领域展示技能的社区成员。

Let’s have a brief look at each certification to see if the CKA is the right fit for you.

下面我们简要了解每一种认证，看看 CKA 是否适合你。

Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)Kubernetes 与云原生助理（KCNA）

KCNA is an entry-level certification program for anyone interested in cloud native application development, runtime environments, and tooling. While the exam does cover Kubernetes, it does not expect you to interact with a cluster directly. This exam consists of multiple-choice questions and is suitable to candidates interested in the topic with a broad exposure to the ecosystem.

KCNA 是面向所有对云原生应用开发、运行时环境和工具链感兴趣者的入门级认证。考试虽然涉及 Kubernetes，但不要求你直接操作集群。它由选择题组成，适合对该主题感兴趣、并已广泛接触云原生生态的考生。

Kubernetes and Cloud Native Security Associate (KCSA)Kubernetes 与云原生安全助理（KCSA）

The KCSA verifies your basic knowledge of security concepts and their application in a Kubernetes cluster. The breadth, depth, and format of the program is definitely more advanced than the KCNA. I personally would not categorize this exam as suitable to beginners to security concepts. You may want to take the KCSA after gaining more hands-on and in-depth exposure to Kubernetes, as the exam questions can be quite hard to answer.

KCSA 验证你对安全基本概念及其在 Kubernetes 集群中应用的理解。该考试在广度、深度和形式上都明显比 KCNA 更高级。我个人不认为它适合安全概念的初学者。建议在积累更多 Kubernetes 动手与深入经验之后再考 KCSA，因为考题相当难答。

Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)认证 Kubernetes 应用开发者（CKAD）

The CKAD exam focuses on verifying your ability to build, configure, and deploy a microservices-based application to Kubernetes. You are not expected to actually implement an application; however, the exam is suitable for developers familiar with topics like application architecture, runtimes, and programming languages.

CKAD 考试聚焦于验证你在 Kubernetes 上构建、配置和部署基于微服务应用的能力。它不要求你真正实现一个应用，但适合熟悉应用架构、运行时和编程语言等主题的开发者。

— PDF p.26 —

Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)认证 Kubernetes 管理员（CKA）

The target audience for the CKA exam is DevOps practitioners, system administrators, and site reliability engineers. This exam tests your ability to perform in the role of a Kubernetes administrator, which includes tasks like cluster, network, storage, and beginner-level security management, with emphasis on troubleshooting scenarios.

CKA 考试的目标受众是 DevOps 从业者、系统管理员和站点可靠性工程师（SRE）。它考察你胜任 Kubernetes 管理员角色的能力，包括集群、网络、存储和入门级安全管理等任务，并重点考查故障排查场景。

Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS)认证 Kubernetes 安全专家（CKS）

The CKS exam expands on the topics verified by the CKA exam. Passing the CKA is a prerequisite before you can sign up for the CKS exam. For this certification, you are expected to have a deeper knowledge of Kubernetes security. The curriculum covers topics like applying best practices for building containerized applications and ensuring a secure Kubernetes runtime environment.

CKS 考试在 CKA 考查主题之上进一步扩展。通过 CKA 是报名 CKS 的前置条件。该认证要求你对 Kubernetes 安全有更深入的理解，课程涵盖构建容器化应用的最佳实践，以及确保 Kubernetes 运行时环境安全等主题。

Exam Objectives考试大纲

Kubernetes clusters need to be installed, configured, and maintained by skilled professionals. That’s the job of a Kubernetes administrator. The CKA certification program verifies a deep understanding of the typical administration tasks encountered on the job: more specifically, Kubernetes cluster maintenance, networking, storage solutions, and troubleshooting applications and cluster nodes.

Kubernetes 集群需要由熟练的专业人员来安装、配置和维护——这正是 Kubernetes 管理员的工作。CKA 认证验证你对工作中常见管理任务的深入理解：具体而言，包括 Kubernetes 集群维护、网络、存储方案，以及应用与集群节点的故障排查。

This book focuses on getting you ready for the CKA exam. I will give a little bit of background on why Kubernetes is important to administrators before dissecting the topics important to the exam.

本书聚焦于帮你备考 CKA 考试。在剖析考试重点主题之前，我会先简要介绍 Kubernetes 为何对管理员重要。

Kubernetes version used during the exam考试使用的 Kubernetes 版本

At the time of writing, the exam is based on Kubernetes 1.33. All content in this book will follow the features, APIs, and command-line support for that version. It’s possible that future versions will break backward compatibility. While preparing for the certification, review the Kubernetes release notes and practice with the Kubernetes version used during the exam to avoid unpleasant surprises. The exam environment will be aligned with the most recent Kubernetes minor version within approximately four to eight weeks of the Kubernetes release date.

写作本书时，考试基于 Kubernetes 1.33。本书所有内容都遵循该版本的特性、API 和命令行支持。未来版本有可能破坏向后兼容性。备考时请阅读 Kubernetes 发行说明，并使用考试所采用的 Kubernetes 版本练习，以避免意外。考试环境会在 Kubernetes 版本发布后约四到八周内，对齐到最新的次版本。

— PDF p.27 —

Curriculum考试大纲构成

The following overview lists the high-level sections, or domains, of the exam and their scoring weights:

下面概览列出考试的高级部分（即 domain，考试域）及其分值权重：

  • 25%: Cluster Architecture, Installation, and Configuration25%：集群架构、安装与配置
  • 15%: Workloads and Scheduling15%：工作负载与调度
  • 20%: Servicing and Networking20%：服务与网络
  • 10%: Storage10%：存储
  • 30%: Troubleshooting30%：故障排查

The next sections detail each domain.

接下来的小节逐一介绍每个考试域。

Cluster Architecture, Installation, and Configuration集群架构、安装与配置

This section of the curriculum dives deep into all aspects of Kubernetes clusters. It covers the fundamental architecture of Kubernetes, including the distinction between the control plane and worker nodes, high-availability configurations, and the tools needed for installing, upgrading, and maintaining a cluster. Additionally, you’ll explore key extension interfaces and learn practical skills such as installing a cluster from scratch, upgrading its version, and backing up/restoring the etcd database.

本考试域深入探讨 Kubernetes 集群的方方面面。它涵盖 Kubernetes 的基本架构，包括控制平面与工作节点的区别、高可用配置，以及安装、升级和维护集群所需的工具。此外，你还会了解关键扩展接口，并学会从零安装集群、升级版本、备份/恢复 etcd 数据库等实用技能。

The CNCF has also incorporated related topics into this domain. For instance, mastering role-based access control (RBAC) is essential for administrators to effectively manage access to cluster resources. You’ll also become proficient in installing Kubernetes operators and using tools like Kustomize and Helm to discover and deploy cluster components efficiently.

CNCF 还把相关主题纳入了本域。例如，掌握基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）对管理员有效管理集群资源访问至关重要。你还将熟练安装 Kubernetes Operator，并使用 Kustomize、Helm 等工具高效发现和部署集群组件。

Workloads and Scheduling工作负载与调度

Administrators must have a solid understanding of Kubernetes concepts essential for managing cloud native applications effectively. The domain focuses on these critical aspects. It covers key resources such as Deployments, ReplicaSets, and configuration management using ConfigMaps and Secrets.

管理员必须扎实理解有效管理云原生应用所必需的 Kubernetes 概念。本考试域聚焦这些关键方面，涵盖 Deployment、ReplicaSet 等核心资源，以及使用 ConfigMap 和 Secret 进行配置管理。

When a new Pod is created, the Kubernetes scheduler assigns it to an available node based on predefined criteria. Scheduling rules, such as node affinity and taints/tolerations, help fine-tune this process to meet specific requirements. For exam preparation, it’s crucial to grasp the various factors and concepts involved in the Kubernetes scheduling algorithm to ensure optimal workload placement and performance.

新建 Pod 时，Kubernetes 调度器会根据预定义标准把它分配到某个可用节点。节点亲和性、污点/容忍等调度规则可帮助微调这一过程以满足特定需求。备考时，务必掌握 Kubernetes 调度算法涉及的各种因素与概念，以实现工作负载的最优放置与性能。

— PDF p.28 —

Servicing and Networking服务与网络

A cloud native microservice rarely operates in isolation. More often than not, it interacts with other microservices or external systems. For administrators, understanding Pod-to-Pod communication, exposing applications to external clients, and configuring cluster networking is crucial for maintaining a fully functional system.

云原生微服务很少孤立运行，它通常要与其他微服务或外部系统交互。对管理员而言，理解 Pod 间通信、把应用暴露给外部客户端、配置集群网络，对于维持系统正常运行至关重要。

This domain of the exam evaluates your knowledge of essential Kubernetes networking primitives, including Services, Ingress, NetworkPolicy, and the Gateway API. Mastering these components ensures you can effectively manage and secure communication within and outside the cluster.

本考试域评估你对 Kubernetes 核心网络原语的掌握，包括 Service、Ingress、NetworkPolicy 和 Gateway API。掌握这些组件，你就能有效管理和保护集群内外的通信。

Storage存储

This domain focuses on the various types of volumes used for reading and writing data in Kubernetes. As an administrator, you must understand how to create, configure, and manage these volumes effectively.

本考试域聚焦 Kubernetes 中用于读写数据的各类 volume。作为管理员，你必须理解如何有效地创建、配置和管理这些 volume。

PersistentVolumes (PVs) play a crucial role in ensuring data persistence, even after a cluster node restarts. You’ll need to demonstrate the ability to mount a PersistentVolume to a specific path within a container and understand the underlying mechanics. Additionally, it’s essential to grasp the differences between static and dynamic provisioning to manage storage resources efficiently.

PersistentVolume（PV）在确保数据持久化方面扮演关键角色——即使集群节点重启数据也不丢失。你需要展示把 PV 挂载到容器内特定路径的能力，并理解其底层机制。此外，还必须掌握静态供应与动态供应的区别，以高效管理存储资源。

Troubleshooting故障排查

In production Kubernetes clusters, issues are bound to arise. Applications may misbehave, become unresponsive, or even become completely inaccessible. Additionally, cluster nodes might crash or face configuration problems. Developing effective troubleshooting strategies is critical to quickly identifying and resolving these situations to minimize downtime and disruption.

在生产 Kubernetes 集群中，问题总会出现：应用可能行为异常、无响应，甚至完全不可访问；集群节点也可能崩溃或出现配置问题。制定有效的故障排查策略，对于快速定位并解决问题、最小化停机和中断至关重要。

This domain carries the highest scoring weight in the exam. You will encounter realistic scenarios that require you to diagnose problems and implement the appropriate solutions. Mastering these skills ensures you can maintain the stability and reliability of Kubernetes environments under pressure.

本考试域在整张试卷中分值权重最高。你会遇到逼真的场景，需要诊断问题并实施恰当的解决方案。掌握这些技能，你就能在压力下维持 Kubernetes 环境的稳定与可靠。

Involved Kubernetes Primitives涉及的 Kubernetes 原语

Some of the exam objectives can be covered by understanding the relevant core Kubernetes primitives. Be aware that the exam combines multiple concepts in a single problem. Refer to Figure 1-2 as a guide to the applicable Kubernetes resources and their relationships.

部分考试目标可以通过理解相关的 Kubernetes 核心原语来覆盖。请注意，考试会在一道题中综合多个概念。请参考图 1-2，它展示了相关 Kubernetes 资源及其关系。

— PDF p.29 —

Documentation可参考的官方文档

During the exam, you are permitted to open a well-defined list of web pages as a reference. You can freely browse those pages and copy-paste code to the exam terminal. The official Kubernetes documentation includes the reference manual and the blog. In addition, you can also browse the Helm documentation:

考试期间，你被允许打开一组明确规定的网页作为参考。你可以自由浏览这些页面，并把代码复制粘贴到考试终端。官方 Kubernetes 文档包括参考手册和博客；此外还可以浏览 Helm 文档：

  • Reference manual: https://kubernetes.io/docs参考手册：https://kubernetes.io/docs
  • Blog: https://kubernetes.io/blog博客：https://kubernetes.io/blog
  • Helm: https://helm.sh/docsHelm 文档：https://helm.sh/docs
— PDF p.30 —

Having the Kubernetes documentation pages at hand is extremely valuable, but make sure you know where to find the relevant information within those pages. In preparation for the test, read all the documentation pages from start to end at least once. Don’t forget the search functionality of the official documentation pages. For reference, Appendix B maps the exam objectives to the book chapters covering the topics and the relevant Kubernetes documentation pages.

手边有 Kubernetes 文档非常有价值，但务必知道在这些页面里去哪里找相关信息。备考时请至少从头到尾通读一遍所有文档页面。不要忘记官方文档的搜索功能。作为参考，附录 B 把考试目标映射到了本书覆盖该主题的章节以及相关 Kubernetes 文档页面。

Using the documentation efficiently高效使用文档

Using a search term will likely lead you to the right documentation pages quicker than navigating the menu items. Copying and pasting code snippets from the documentation into the console of the exam environment works reasonably well. You may have to adjust the YAML indentation manually as the proper formatting can get lost in the process.

用搜索词查找，通常比逐级点击菜单更快到达正确的文档页面。把文档中的代码片段复制粘贴到考试环境的控制台基本可行；但你可能需要手动调整 YAML 缩进，因为粘贴过程中格式可能丢失。

Exam Environment and Tips考试环境与提示

To take the exam, you must purchase a registration voucher, which can be acquired on the CNCF training and certification web page. On occasion, the CNCF offers discounts for the voucher (e.g., around the US Thanksgiving holiday). Those discount offers are often announced on the Linux Foundation LinkedIn page.

要参加考试，你必须先在 CNCF 培训与认证网页上购买报名 voucher（ voucher 即考试券）。CNCF 偶尔会提供 voucher 折扣（例如美国感恩节前后）。这类折扣信息通常发布在 Linux基金会的 LinkedIn 页面上。

After you purchase the voucher, you can schedule a time for the exam with PSI, the company conducting the test virtually. In-person exams at a testing facility are not available. On the day of your scheduled test, you’ll be asked to log into the test platform with a URL provided to you by email. You’ll be asked to enable the audio and video feed on your computer to discourage cheating. A proctor will oversee your actions via audio/video feed and terminate the session if they think you are not following the rules.

购买 voucher 后，你可以与 PSI（远程监考公司）预约考试时间。考试不提供在考试中心的线下形式。考试当天，你会通过邮件收到的 URL 登录考试平台，并被要求开启电脑音视频以防作弊。监考员会通过音视频监控你的操作，若认为你违反规则会终止考试会话。

— PDF p.31 —
Exam attempts考试次数

The voucher you purchased grants two attempts to pass the exam. I recommend preparing reasonably well before taking the test on the first attempt. It will give you a fair chance to pass the test and provide a good impression of the exam environment and the complexity of the questions. Don’t sweat it if you do not pass the test on the first attempt. You’ve got another free shot.

你购买的 voucher 提供两次考试机会。我建议在第一次正式考试前做较充分的准备——这既能给你一次公平的通过机会，也能让你切身感受考试环境和题目难度。即使第一次没过也别太在意，你还有一次免费机会。

The exam has a time limit of two hours. During that time, you’ll need to solve hands-on problems on a real, predefined Kubernetes cluster. Every question will state the cluster you need to work on. This practical approach to gauge a candidate’s skill set is superior to tests with multiple-choice questions, as you can translate the knowledge directly to tasks performed on the job.

考试限时两小时。在这段时间里，你需要在一个真实的、预先准备好的 Kubernetes 集群上动手解决问题。每道题都会指明你需要操作哪个集群。这种以实操衡量考生技能的方式优于选择题，因为你可以把知识直接转化为工作中执行的任务。

I highly recommend reading the FAQ for the exam. You will find answers to most of your pressing questions there, including system requirements for your machine, scoring, certification renewal, and retake requirements.

我强烈建议阅读考试 FAQ。你最关心的大部分问题都能在那里找到答案，包括机器系统要求、评分方式、证书续期和重考要求。

Candidate Skills考生应具备的技能

The certification assumes that you have a basic understanding of Kubernetes. You should be familiar with Kubernetes internals, its core concepts, and the command-line tool kubectl. The CNCF offers a free “Introduction to Kubernetes” course for beginners to Kubernetes.

该认证默认你已具备 Kubernetes 的基础理解，熟悉 Kubernetes 内部原理、核心概念和命令行工具 kubectl。CNCF 为 Kubernetes 初学者提供了一门免费的“Introduction to Kubernetes”课程。

Here’s a brief overview of the background knowledge you need to increase your likelihood of passing the exam:

下面简要列出你需要具备的背景知识，以提高通过考试的概率：

Kubernetes architecture and conceptsKubernetes 架构与概念

The exam won’t ask you to install a Kubernetes cluster from scratch. Read up on the basics of Kubernetes and its architectural components. Reference Chapter 2 for a jump start on Kubernetes architecture and concepts.

考试不会要求你从零安装 Kubernetes 集群。请阅读 Kubernetes 基础及其架构组件。可参考第 2 章快速入门 Kubernetes 架构与概念。

The kubectl CLI toolkubectl 命令行工具

The kubectl command-line tool is the central tool you will use during the exam to interact with the Kubernetes cluster. Even if you have only a little time to prepare for the exam, it’s essential to practice operating kubectl, as well as its commands and their relevant options. You will have no access to the web dashboard UI during the exam. Chapter 3 provides a short summary of the most important ways of interacting with a Kubernetes cluster.

kubectl 是考试期间你与 Kubernetes 集群交互的核心工具。即便备考时间有限，也必须练习 kubectl 的操作、命令及相关选项。考试期间你无法使用 Web 控制台 UI。第 3 章简要总结了与 Kubernetes 集群交互的最重要方式。

Kubernetes cluster maintenance toolsKubernetes 集群维护工具

Installing a Kubernetes cluster from scratch and upgrading the Kubernetes version of an existing cluster is performed using the tool kubeadm. It’s important to understand its usage and the relevant steps to walk through the process. Reference Chapter 4 for more information. Additionally, you need to have a good understanding of the tools etcdctl and etcdutl, including their command-line options for backing up and restoring the etcd database covered in Chapter 5.

从零安装 Kubernetes 集群、以及升级现有集群的 Kubernetes 版本，都使用 kubeadm 工具。理解它的用法和相关步骤很重要，详见第 4 章。此外，你还需要熟悉 etcdctl 和 etcdutl 工具，包括第 5 章介绍的备份与恢复 etcd 数据库的命令行选项。

Working knowledge of a container runtime engine容器运行时引擎的实操知识

Kubernetes uses a container runtime engine for managing images. The default container runtime engine in Kubernetes is containerd. At a minimum, understand the difference between container images and containers, and their purpose. This topic goes beyond the coverage of this book and isn’t directly tested for in the exam.

Kubernetes 使用容器运行时引擎来管理镜像，默认运行时是 containerd。至少要理解容器镜像与容器的区别及其用途。该主题超出本书范围，考试也不直接考查。

— PDF p.32 —

Foundational Linux knowledgeLinux 基础

The exam is conducted entirely through a Linux terminal, requiring solid command-line skills. You should be comfortable navigating the file system, managing files and directories, and understanding file permissions. Familiarity with text editors like vi or vim is essential, as you’ll need to edit YAML files frequently. Basic process management skills such as viewing running processes, checking resource usage, and understanding system logs are important for troubleshooting tasks. You should also be comfortable with common Linux commands for text processing (grep, awk, sed), file operations (cat, less, head, tail), and basic shell scripting concepts including piping, redirection, and environment variables. Knowledge of SSH for accessing remote nodes and basic networking commands (netstat, curl, wget) will also prove valuable during the exam.

考试完全通过 Linux 终端进行，需要扎实的命令行技能。你应当熟练在文件系统中导航、管理文件与目录、理解文件权限。熟悉 vi/vim 等文本编辑器是必须的，因为你会频繁编辑 YAML 文件。基本的进程管理技能（查看运行中的进程、检查资源占用、理解系统日志）对故障排查很重要。你还应熟悉常用 Linux 命令：文本处理（grep、awk、sed）、文件操作（cat、less、head、tail），以及管道、重定向、环境变量等基本 shell 脚本概念。用 SSH 访问远程节点，以及 netstat、curl、wget 等基础网络命令的知识，在考试中也很有价值。

Time Management时间管理

The Linux Foundation expects Kubernetes practitioners to be able to apply their knowledge to real-world scenarios by finding solutions to problems in a timely fashion. The exam typically contains 15–20 performance-based questions to be completed in 2 hours, giving you roughly 6–8 minutes per question on average.

Linux 基金会期望 Kubernetes 从业者能把知识应用到真实场景中，及时找到问题的解决方案。考试通常包含 15–20 道实操题，需在 2 小时内完成，平均每题约 6–8 分钟。

Since no single strategy works for everyone, consider these approaches for managing the exam’s time constraints. One option is to read through all questions first before attempting any, allowing you to mentally sort them by perceived difficulty and tackle easier ones first to build confidence and secure quick points. Alternatively, you could take questions in the order presented but strictly time-box each to 4–5 minutes (leaving buffer time for review), marking incomplete ones for return, then using your second pass to revisit flagged questions ordered by difficulty or remaining work needed. A hybrid approach combines both strategies: initially scan all questions to assess difficulty, then work through them with strict time-boxes, leaving a third pass for reassessing and completing questions where you’ve made partial progress or gained clarity from working through similar problems.

没有一种策略适合所有人，可参考以下方法应对考试时间压力。一种做法是先通览所有题目再动手，按主观难度在心里排序，先做简单题以建立信心、稳拿分数。另一种做法是按顺序做题，但每题严格限时 4–5 分钟（留出复查缓冲时间），没做完的做标记跳过，第二遍再按难度或剩余工作量回头处理。混合策略则把两者结合：先扫一遍全部题评估难度，然后严格限时做题，最后留第三遍回头复核并完成那些已部分完成、或在做过类似题后思路更清晰的题目。

The key is having a deliberate strategy rather than getting stuck on difficult questions early, as the exam rewards breadth of knowledge and efficient time management over perfecting individual complex scenarios. Remember that partial credit is often available, so it’s better to attempt all questions than to perfect just a few.

关键是要有一套深思熟虑的策略，而不是一开始就卡在难题上——考试奖励的是知识广度和高效时间管理，而非把单个复杂场景做到完美。记住通常有部分分，所以把所有题都尝试一遍，远胜只把少数几题做透。

Command-Line Tips and Tricks命令行技巧

Given that the command line is your solitary interface to the Kubernetes cluster, it’s essential that you become extremely familiar with the kubectl tool and its available options. This section provides tips and tricks for making their use more efficient and productive.

既然命令行是你与 Kubernetes 集群交互的唯一界面，就必须极度熟悉 kubectl 及其可用选项。本节提供一些让使用更高效、更顺手的技巧。

— PDF p.33 —

Setting a Context and Namespace设置 Context 与 Namespace

The exam environment comes with multiple Kubernetes clusters already set up for you. Take a look at the instructions for a high-level, technical overview of those clusters. Each of the exam tasks need to be solved on a designated cluster, as outlined in its description. Furthermore, the instructions will ask you to work in a namespace other than default. Make sure to set the context and namespace as the first course of action before working on a question. The following command sets the context and the namespace as a one-time action:

考试环境已为你预先配置好多个 Kubernetes 集群。请阅读说明，了解这些集群的高层技术概览。每道考试任务都需要在其描述中指定的集群上完成；此外，说明会要求你在 default 之外的某个 namespace 中操作。做题前第一件事务必是设置好 context 和 namespace。下面的命令一次性设置 context 和 namespace：

$ kubectl config set-context <context-of-question> \
  --namespace=<namespace-of-question>
$ kubectl config use-context <context-of-question>

You can find a more detailed discussion of the context concept and the corresponding kubectl commands in “Authentication with kubectl” on page 58.

关于 context 概念及对应 kubectl 命令的更详细讨论，见第 58 页“Authentication with kubectl”。

For specific tasks, e.g., the upgrade process of a cluster node, you will need to open an interactive shell to the host machine of a cluster node. Use the ssh <nodename> command to achieve that.

对于特定任务（例如集群节点的升级过程），你需要打开到某集群节点主机的交互式 shell。使用 ssh <nodename> 命令即可。

Using the Alias for kubectl使用 kubectl 别名

In the course of the exam, you will have to execute the kubectl command tens or even hundreds of times. You might be an extremely fast typist; however, there’s no point in fully spelling out the executable over and over again. The exam environment already sets up the alias k for the kubectl command.

考试过程中你会执行几十甚至上百次 kubectl 命令。即便你打字极快，也没必要每次都拼出完整命令。考试环境已经为 kubectl 设置了别名 k。

In preparation for the exam, you can set up the same behavior on your machine. The following alias command maps the letter k to the full kubectl command:

备考时你可以在自己的机器上设置同样的别名。下面的 alias 命令把字母 k 映射到完整的 kubectl 命令：

$ alias k=kubectl
$ k version

Using kubectl Command Auto-Completion使用 kubectl 命令自动补全

Memorizing kubectl commands and command-line options takes a lot of practice. The exam environment comes with auto-completion enabled by default. You can find instructions for setting up auto-completion for the shell on your machine in the Kubernetes documentation.

记住 kubectl 命令和命令行选项需要大量练习。考试环境默认开启了自动补全。你可以在 Kubernetes 文档中找到在自己 shell 上配置自动补全的说明。

Internalizing Resource Short Names牢记资源短名

Many of the kubectl commands can be quite lengthy. For example, the command for managing PersistentVolumeClaims is persistentvolumeclaims. Spelling out the full command can be error-prone and time-consuming. Thankfully, some of the longer commands come with a short-form usage. The command api-resources lists all available commands plus their short names:

很多 kubectl 资源名相当长，例如管理 PersistentVolumeClaim 的资源名是 persistentvolumeclaims。每次拼全称既容易出错又耗时。幸好一些较长的命令提供了简写。api-resources 命令会列出所有可用资源及其短名：

— PDF p.34 —
$ kubectl api-resources
NAME                    SHORTNAMES  APIGROUP  NAMESPACED  KIND
...
persistentvolumeclaims  pvc                   true        PersistentVolumeClaim
...

Using pvc instead of persistentvolumeclaims results in a more concise and expressive command execution, as shown here:

用 pvc 代替 persistentvolumeclaims 会让命令更简洁清晰，如下所示：

$ kubectl describe pvc my-claim

Practicing and Practice Exams练习与模拟考试

Hands-on practice is extremely important when it comes to passing the exam. For that purpose, you’ll need a functioning Kubernetes cluster environment. The following options stand out:

要通过考试，动手练习极其重要。为此你需要一个可用的 Kubernetes 集群环境。以下几个选择值得推荐：

  • I found it useful to run one or many virtual machines using Vagrant and VirtualBox. Those tools help with creating an isolated Kubernetes environment that is easy to bootstrap and dispose on demand.我发现用 Vagrant + VirtualBox 跑一台或多台虚拟机很有用。这些工具能帮你创建隔离的 Kubernetes 环境，按需快速启动和销毁。
  • It is relatively easy to install a simple Kubernetes cluster on your developer machine. The Kubernetes documentation provides various installation options, depending on your operating system. minikube is useful when it comes to experimenting with more advanced features like Ingress or storage classes, as it provides the necessary functionality as add-ons that can be installed with a single command. Alternatively, you can also give kind a try; it’s another tool for running local Kubernetes clusters.在开发机上安装一个简单的 Kubernetes 集群相对容易。Kubernetes 文档按操作系统提供了多种安装方式。minikube 在实验 Ingress、存储类等较高级特性时很有用——它把这些功能作为附加组件，一条命令即可安装。你也可以试试 kind，另一个运行本地 Kubernetes 集群的工具。
  • If you’re a subscriber to the O’Reilly Learning Platform, you have unlimited access to scenarios running a Kubernetes sandbox environment. In addition, you can test your knowledge with the help of the CKA exam prep interactive labs.如果你订阅了 O’Reilly 学习平台，可以无限制使用运行 Kubernetes 沙箱环境的实操场景；还可以借助 CKA 备考交互式实验来检验知识。
  • Killercoda hosts interactive scenarios for the exam contributed by the Kubernetes community.Killercoda 上托管了 Kubernetes 社区贡献的考试交互式场景。

You may also want to try one of the following commercial learning and practice resources:

你也可以试试以下商业学习与练习资源：

  • Killer Shell is a simulator with sample exercises for all Kubernetes certifications. If you purchase a voucher for the exam, you will be allowed two free sessions.Killer Shell 是一个模拟器，提供所有 Kubernetes 认证的样题练习。如果你购买了考试 voucher，可免费使用两次。
  • Other online training providers offer video courses for the exam, some of which include an integrated Kubernetes practice environment. I would like to mention KodeKloud and Pluralsight. You’ll need to purchase a subscription to access the content for each course individually.其他在线培训提供商也提供考试视频课程，其中一些内置了 Kubernetes 练习环境。我想推荐 KodeKloud 和 Pluralsight；它们需要单独订阅才能访问每门课程内容。
— PDF p.35 —

Summary本章小结

The exam is a completely hands-on test that requires you to solve problems in multiple Kubernetes clusters. You’re expected to understand, use, and configure the Kubernetes primitives relevant to administrators. The exam curriculum subdivides those focus areas and puts different weights on topics, which determines their contributions to the overall score. Even though focus areas are grouped meaningfully, the curriculum doesn’t necessarily follow a natural learning path, so it’s helpful to cross-reference chapters in the book in preparation for the exam.

这是一场完全实操的考试，要求你在多个 Kubernetes 集群中解决问题。你需要理解、使用并配置与管理员相关的 Kubernetes 原语。考试大纲把这些重点领域细分，并对不同主题赋予不同权重，决定它们对总分的贡献。尽管重点领域分组合理，但大纲并不一定遵循自然的学习路径，因此备考时交叉参考本书各章会很有帮助。

In this chapter, we discussed the exam environment and how to navigate it. The key to acing the exam is intense practice of kubectl to solve real-world scenarios. The next two chapters in Part I will provide a jump start to Kubernetes.

本章讨论了考试环境及其应对方式。通过考试的关键是大量练习用 kubectl 解决真实场景问题。第 I 部分接下来的两章将带你快速入门 Kubernetes。

All chapters that discuss domain details give you an opportunity to practice hands-on. You will find sample exercises at the end of each chapter.

所有详解考试域的章节都为你提供动手机会：每章末尾都有样题练习。

— PDF p.36 —
